title: 灭火器的种类与选用
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/032_灭火器的种类与选用.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/032_灭火器的种类与选用/src.py

points.K1: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
points.K2: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火
points.K3: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火
points.K4: 液体火、带电火不能用水泼
points.K6: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
points.K7: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
points.K8: 小房间喷二氧化碳会缺氧
points.K9: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
points.K10: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
points.K11: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排不同灭火器前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of different red fire extinguishers, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲灭火器的种类与选用。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 实验台上小溶剂火，阿杰端起一杯水要泼
shots.prompt_en: A small solvent fire flickers on a bench tray; the young male student lifts a beaker of water to throw on it.
shots.narration: 台面溶剂着火，阿杰想端水去泼。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住阿杰，指向墙边的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him with her hand and points to a fire extinguisher by the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先看灭火器能灭哪类火！

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 五种灭火器并排，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Five different fire extinguisher icons stand side by side with a question mark above them. No text.
shots.narration: 灭火器有好几种，没有万能的。
overlay: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 灭火器铭牌上的A、B、C等类别图标放大
shots.prompt_en: A blank extinguisher label is zoomed in, showing fire class icons: wood, liquid drop, gas, plug. No text.
shots.narration: 铭牌标明它能灭哪几类火。

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校实验室灭火器铭牌特写，镜头从灭火剂名称移到适用火灾类别（近景，遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fire extinguisher label area with agent and fire class icons. No text.
shots.narration: 看灭火剂名称和适用类别。

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 一本国标书和灭火器，国外色带图表打叉
shots.prompt_en: A national standard book icon next to an extinguisher gets a check; a foreign color-band chart is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 国内按国标和铭牌选，不靠颜色认。

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 六类火灾图标和对应灭火器连线
shots.prompt_en: Six fire class icons are linked by lines to matching extinguisher icons. No text.
shots.narration: 先判断火灾类别，再选灭火器。

shots.section_title: 没有万能灭火器，按火灾类别选
shots.scene: 灭火器用错，火反而更大，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The wrong extinguisher is used and the flame grows bigger, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错了，火可能更大。

shots.section_title: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火
shots.scene: 水基型灭火器喷向燃烧的木头和纸
shots.prompt_en: A water-based extinguisher sprays onto burning wood and paper, steam rising. No faces.
shots.narration: 水基型灭火器，靠冷却降温灭火。
overlay: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火

shots.section_title: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火
shots.scene: 木材纸张火被扑灭，温度计下降
shots.prompt_en: The wood and paper fire goes out and a thermometer icon drops. No people.
shots.narration: 适合A类：木头、纸张、布料着火。

shots.section_title: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火
shots.scene: 带电设备、油锅、气瓶火三个图标前水流打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a plugged-in device, a frying pan and a gas cylinder, each with a water stream crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 带电、油锅、气体着火，不用水型。

shots.section_title: 水基型灭火器：靠冷却，扑A类火
shots.scene: 铭牌上带E类标志的水基型灭火器，问号变勾
shots.prompt_en: A water-based extinguisher label shows an extra plug icon; a question mark turns into a check. No text.
shots.narration: 个别型号能扑带电火，以铭牌为准。

shots.section_title: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火
shots.scene: 泡沫灭火器喷出泡沫，盖住油盘液面火
shots.prompt_en: A foam extinguisher lays a thick foam blanket over a burning liquid in a tray. No faces.
shots.narration: 泡沫灭火器，泡沫盖住液面。
overlay: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火

shots.section_title: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火
shots.scene: 泡沫隔绝空气、同时冷却的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram shows foam blocking air from the liquid surface while cooling it. No text.
shots.narration: 隔绝空气，又能冷却。

shots.section_title: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火
shots.scene: 汽油、油类液体着火图标，配B类灭火器打勾
shots.prompt_en: Fuel and oil liquid fire icons get a check next to an extinguisher with a liquid drop icon. No text.
shots.narration: B类液体火，选标有B类的灭火器。

shots.section_title: 泡沫灭火器：扑固体和液体火
shots.scene: 泡沫灭火器对带电设备、金属、油锅打叉
shots.prompt_en: A foam extinguisher is crossed out in front of a powered device, a burning metal and a frying pan. No text.
shots.narration: 泡沫含水，带电和金属火不能用。

shots.section_title: 液体火、带电火不能用水泼
shots.scene: 溶剂火上泼水，火随水流蔓延，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Water thrown onto a solvent fire makes the burning liquid spread across the bench, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂着火泼水，火会随水蔓延。
overlay: 液体火、带电火不能用水泼

shots.section_title: 液体火、带电火不能用水泼
shots.scene: 带电设备泼水，电弧沿水流传导，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Water thrown at a burning plugged-in instrument conducts an electric arc, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 电器着火泼水，还可能触电。

shots.section_title: 液体火、带电火不能用水泼
shots.scene: 燃油桶着火，用干粉灭火器扑救，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small fuel can fire is put out with a dry powder extinguisher, with a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 燃油着火，用干粉、二氧化碳或灭火毯。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: 干粉灭火器喷出粉雾
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher sprays a cloud of powder at a small fire. No faces.
shots.narration: 干粉灭火器，最常用的一类。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: 粉末打断火焰中链式反应的示意
shots.prompt_en: Powder particles break the chain reaction links inside a flame diagram. No text.
shots.narration: 粉末能打断燃烧的链式反应。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: ABC干粉对固体、液体、气体火图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher with three checks for wood, liquid and gas fire icons. No text.
shots.narration: ABC干粉：固体、液体、气体火都能灭。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: BC干粉对木头纸张火打问号，余烬复燃
shots.prompt_en: A BC powder extinguisher puts out burning wood, but embers glow and reignite; a warning mark appears. No text.
shots.narration: BC干粉灭固体火，容易复燃。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: 干粉扑灭插头火，旁边先拉闸断电
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the main power, then dry powder puts out a small fire at a power cord. No faces.
shots.narration: 也能扑带电初起火，能断电先断电。

shots.section_title: 干粉灭火器：ABC型和BC型
shots.scene: 精密仪器被粉末覆盖，难以清理
shots.prompt_en: A precision instrument is covered in white powder that is hard to clean. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点：粉末难清理，会损坏仪器。

shots.section_title: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
shots.scene: 实验室出口旁挂着干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder fire extinguisher hangs on the wall right next to a lab exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室最常配干粉，多放在出口旁。
overlay: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪

shots.section_title: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校实验室出口旁的干粉灭火器全景到近景，停在压力表上（遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a lab exit with a wall-mounted dry powder extinguisher, then a close-up of its pressure gauge.
shots.narration: 它能扑救多种常见初起火灾。

shots.section_title: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
shots.scene: 阿杰进实验室，先看一眼灭火器位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a lab and glances at the extinguisher location first.
shots.narration: 每间实验室都配灭火器，先记住位置。

shots.section_title: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
shots.scene: 火大一些的场景，小研快步取来灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly fetches the extinguisher from beside the exit.
shots.narration: 火大一点，就要用灭火器扑救。

shots.section_title: 干粉最常见，记住它放在哪
shots.scene: 旧式灭火器图标和臭氧层破洞，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An old-style extinguisher icon beside a hole in the ozone layer, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 哈龙灭火器破坏臭氧层，已基本淘汰。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器喷出白色气雾
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher with a large horn nozzle releases white cold vapor. No faces.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器，喷出的是气体。
overlay: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器对液体、气体、带电设备图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher with checks next to liquid, gas and plugged-in device icons. No text.
shots.narration: 适合液体火、气体火和带电设备火。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 仪器室精密仪器旁的二氧化碳灭火器，仪器干净
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher stands beside clean precision instruments in an instrument room. No people.
shots.narration: 不留残渣，仪器室、机房常配。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 木材火被吹灭后余烬复燃，金属火和油锅打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wood fire put out by carbon dioxide reignites from embers; burning metal and frying pan icons are crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 固体火易复燃，金属和油锅火别用。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 【实拍】二氧化碳灭火器喷射软管与喇叭筒特写，手握在把手上（训练器材，不喷放）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a carbon dioxide extinguisher hose and horn, a gloved hand holding the handle, not the horn.
shots.narration: 喷射时别握喇叭筒，防止冻伤。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：不留残渣，适合仪器
shots.scene: 手握喇叭筒结霜打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bare hand gripping a frosted horn nozzle is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 喇叭筒温度很低，会冻伤手。

shots.section_title: 小房间喷二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 小房间里二氧化碳气体填满，氧气图标减少
shots.prompt_en: In a small closed room, carbon dioxide fills the space and oxygen icons shrink. No people.
shots.narration: 小房间喷二氧化碳，氧气被挤走。
overlay: 小房间喷二氧化碳会缺氧

shots.section_title: 小房间喷二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 人形图标头晕，警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A figure icon feels dizzy in the gas-filled room, with a warning triangle. No faces.
shots.narration: 人留在里面会窒息。

shots.section_title: 小房间喷二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 老周喷完后退出房间，关门，之后开窗通风
shots.prompt_en: The older man steps out of the small room after use and closes the door; later windows are opened.
shots.narration: 用完马上撤出，通风后再进。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
shots.scene: 一块活泼金属燃烧，发出耀眼白光
shots.prompt_en: A piece of reactive metal burns with a dazzling white light on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 活泼金属着火，实验室里较少见。
overlay: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
shots.scene: 水和二氧化碳喷向金属火，火势更猛，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Water and carbon dioxide sprayed at the burning metal make it flare up, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用水，二氧化碳也会更危险。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
shots.scene: 普通干粉灭火器对金属火打叉
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary dry powder extinguisher is crossed out in front of the burning metal. No text.
shots.narration: 普通干粉也扑不了活泼金属火。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
shots.scene: 干砂和金属火专用灭火器覆盖金属火，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Dry sand from a bucket and a special metal-fire extinguisher cover the burning metal, with a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 用干砂或金属火专用灭火剂覆盖。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水和二氧化碳
shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫，转身撤离去打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hesitates in front of the metal fire, then turns away to leave and make a call.
shots.narration: 没把握就别扑，撤离并报警。

shots.section_title: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
shots.scene: 炒锅里的食用油着火
shots.prompt_en: Cooking oil in a frying pan on a hot plate catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: 锅里的食用油着火，是F类火。
overlay: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器

shots.section_title: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
shots.scene: 往油锅里泼水，油火飞溅，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Water poured into the burning oil pan makes flaming oil splash out, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 油锅火绝不能泼水。

shots.section_title: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
shots.scene: 关掉热源，盖上锅盖
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the hot plate and slides a lid over the burning pan. No faces.
shots.narration: 先关火，再盖锅盖或灭火毯。

shots.section_title: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
shots.scene: 标有F类图标的专用灭火器喷向油锅，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A special extinguisher marked with a frying pan icon sprays on the pan, with a green check. No text.
shots.narration: 或者用标有F类的专用灭火器。

shots.section_title: 油锅火：盖锅盖或用F类灭火器
shots.scene: 干粉、泡沫对油锅打叉，F类专用灭火器对其他火打叉
shots.prompt_en: Dry powder and foam are crossed out for the pan; the special pan extinguisher is crossed out for other fires. No text.
shots.narration: 普通干粉、泡沫不宜扑油锅火。

shots.section_title: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器
shots.scene: 化学实验室配干粉，仪器室配二氧化碳，金属区备干砂
shots.prompt_en: Three rooms: a chemistry lab with a dry powder extinguisher, an instrument room with a carbon dioxide one, a metal area with a sand bucket. No text.
shots.narration: 灭火器按场所的危险来配置。
overlay: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器

shots.section_title: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器
shots.scene: 王老师在平面图上标出灭火器位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator marks extinguisher locations on a blank floor plan.
shots.narration: 学校按规范配置，不能随意挪走。

shots.section_title: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器
shots.scene: 学生围观激光切割机，欣欣指向墙边灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Students watch a laser cutter at work; the panda mascot points to the extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 看设备运行前，先认认身边的灭火器。

shots.section_title: 按场所配置，先认身边灭火器
shots.scene: 小研在灭火器前看铭牌，点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the extinguisher label and nods.
shots.narration: 在哪、是哪种、能灭什么火，先学会。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤离，拨打119
shots.scene: 火势扩大，阿杰和小研撤出实验室并关门
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; the young male student and the female graduate student leave the lab and close the door.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，马上撤离关门。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤离，拨打119
shots.scene: 手机拨号界面显示119，保卫处值班员接电话
shots.prompt_en: A phone dial screen shows 119; the security officer answers a call at the campus security desk.
shots.narration: 拨打119，说清地点、火情和有无伤员。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤离，拨打119
shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，王老师通知保卫处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator, who calls the security officer.
shots.narration: 同时报告老师和学校保卫处。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 水基、泡沫、干粉、二氧化碳、金属火专用五种灭火器依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five extinguisher icons get green checks one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 先认火灾类别，再看铭牌选灭火器。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 水泼溶剂火、二氧化碳扑金属火、水泼油锅三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three crossed-out scenes: water on a solvent fire, carbon dioxide on burning metal, water on an oil pan. No text.
shots.narration: 液体、带电、金属、油锅，别用错。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿起一具训练灭火器，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a training fire extinguisher and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲灭火器的使用与检查。
